questions.question: My landlord locked me out of my flat yesterday. Should I sue him?

result.query: My landlord locked me out of my flat yesterday. Should I sue him?
result.text:
This needs a lawyer who can look at the details of your situation.

Under Lagos Tenancy Law 2011, a landlord may only lawfully recover possession through certain legal procedures. A notice to quit ends the tenancy but does not give the landlord the right to lock the tenant out. If the tenant stays after the notice to quit expires, the landlord must serve a written notice of the owner's intention to recover possession, giving at least seven days, and only after that can the landlord apply to court.
